body: NeMo Guardrails is an open-source library for applying programmable safety and security controls to LLM and agentic applications.
plain_description: **Add programmable safety and security checks to your AI agents and applications.** Define policies for tool calls, user inputs, and model responses. Use local rules or model-backed checks.
technical_description: An open-source Python library for defining and running programmable safety and security rails for LLM and agentic applications. It supports checks for inputs, outputs, retrieved content, tool calls, and tool results, with Python APIs, a Guardrails server, a gateway, hooks, and framework integrations. Policies can combine deterministic rules with model-backed checks and third-party services. Anonymous usage telemetry is enabled by default and can be disabled with NEMO_GUARDRAILS_NO_USAGE_STATS=1.
title: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails Library
